description:
Agrupa textos casi duplicados (similitud Jaccard de trigramas ≥ umbral) entre hasta 2.000 elementos y conserva el primero. Cuándo: un flujo de agente necesita un resultado exacto y repetible para un paso auxiliar (tokens, costos, reintentos, fragmentos, ranking, limpieza de JSON). No para: eliminar líneas duplicadas conservando la primera aparición y el orden (lines-dedupe). Efectos secundarios: ninguno (solo lectura, sin red, sin estado guardado). Determinista: la misma entrada da la misma salida. Límites: entrada JSON de hasta 64 KB, 1 s por llamada, resultado de hasta 1 MB.

EN: Groups near-duplicate strings (Jaccard similarity of character 3-grams ≥ threshold, accent- and case-insensitive) among up to 2,000 items, keeping the first of each group. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). [EN completo / full EN: inputSchema.description]

inputSchema.description: EN: Groups near-duplicate strings (Jaccard similarity of character 3-grams ≥ threshold, accent- and case-insensitive) among up to 2,000 items, keeping the first of each group. When: an agent loop needs an exact, repeatable result for a bookkeeping step (tokens, costs, retries, chunking, ranking, JSON clean-up). Not for: removing duplicate lines keeping the first occurrence and original order (lines-dedupe). Side effects: none (read-only, no network access, no stored state). Deterministic: the same input gives the same output. Limits: JSON input up to 64 KB, 1 s per call, result up to 1 MB.

items.description: Strings (array of string; required; at least 1 items; up to 2000 items).

threshold.description: Similarity threshold 0-1 (number; optional; default 0.8; min 0; max 1).
